# Tags API Reference

The **`tags`** namespace, available to scripts in the **`minelark/server/`** folder.
Add any ids - vanilla, Minelark's, or another mod's - to item / block / fluid /
entity tags. Written into the generated data pack, reloadable with `/minelark
reload`. A bare tag name uses the conventional `c:` namespace; a bare member id
defaults to `minecraft:`; a `#`-prefixed member includes another tag.

---

## `tags.block(tag, members)`

Adds blocks to a block tag. A bare tag name uses the conventional `c:` namespace.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | - | The tag id, e.g. `"minecraft:mineable/pickaxe"`. |
| `members` | any | yes | - | A list of block ids (or `#tag`). |

---

## `tags.entity(tag, members)`

Adds entity types to an entity-type tag. A bare tag name uses the conventional `c:` namespace.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | - | The tag id, e.g. `"c:bosses"`. |
| `members` | any | yes | - | A list of entity type ids (or `#tag`). |

---

## `tags.fluid(tag, members)`

Adds fluids to a fluid tag. A bare tag name uses the conventional `c:` namespace.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | - | The tag id, e.g. `"minecraft:water"`. |
| `members` | any | yes | - | A list of fluid ids (or `#tag`). |

---

## `tags.item(tag, members)`

Adds items to an item tag. A bare tag name uses the conventional `c:` namespace.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | - | The tag id, e.g. `"c:gems"` or `"minecraft:planks"`. |
| `members` | any | yes | - | A list of item ids (or `#tag` to include another tag). |

---

*The usual Starlark builtins (`print`, `len`, `range`, and so on) work here too. See [The Starlark Language](../language.md).*
